question: Advisor headcount over the last eight quarters across the five.

claims.text: Advisor headcount over the last eight quarters cannot be compared, combined, or ranked across the five firms: each defines and reports the metric differently (different basis). Morgan Stanley reports Wealth Management representatives as its financial advisor headcount; Schwab publishes no count of this metric and instead reports related figures; Edward Jones reports financial advisors across whole-firm, U.S., and Canada bases that shift over the period; Merrill's closest figures come from Bank of America and cover GWIM plus Consumer Banking (a wider group than Merrill alone); Raymond James excludes its RCS division advisors from its financial advisor metric.
Morgan Stanley: The quarterly financial supplement for the period ended December 31, 2020 (published January 20, 2021) reports 15,950 Wealth Management representatives as of December 31, 2020.
Morgan Stanley: The quarterly financial supplement for the period ended December 31, 2020 reports 15,469 Wealth Management representatives as of September 30, 2020.
Morgan Stanley: The quarterly financial supplement for the period ended December 31, 2020 reports 15,468 Wealth Management representatives as of December 31, 2019.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the second quarter of 2026 (period ended June 26, 2026) reports 20,514 financial advisors at period end, whole firm.
Edward Jones: The 10-K for year 2025 (period ended December 31, 2025, published March 13, 2026) reports 20,425 financial advisors at year end, whole firm.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the third quarter of 2025 (period ended September 26, 2025) reports 20,429 financial advisors at period end, whole firm.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the second quarter of 2025 (period ended June 27, 2025) reports 20,309 financial advisors at period end, whole firm.
Edward Jones: The 10-K for year 2025 reports 20,125 financial advisors at year end 2024 (December 31, 2024), whole firm.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the third quarter of 2025 reports 19,885 financial advisors at period end for the third quarter of 2024 (ended September 27, 2024), whole firm.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the first quarter of 2026 (period ended March 27, 2026) reports 19,674 financial advisors at period end in the U.S. segment.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the first quarter of 2026 (period ended March 27, 2026) reports 876 financial advisors at period end in the Canada segment.
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the first quarter of 2026 reports 19,413 financial advisors at period end in the U.S. segment for the first quarter of 2025 (ended March 28, 2025).
Edward Jones: The 10-Q for the first quarter of 2026 reports 875 financial advisors at period end in the Canada segment for the first quarter of 2025 (ended March 28, 2025).

Raymond James Financial: The earnings transcript for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 states Raymond James ended fiscal 2025 with a record 8,943 total financial advisors as of September 30, 2025, comprising 3,878 employee financial advisors and 5,065 independent contractors; its 10-K notes that advisors in its RCS division are not included in this metric although their client assets are included in PCG AUA.
Raymond James Financial: The 10-K for fiscal 2025 reports 8,787 total financial advisors as of September 30, 2024, comprising 3,826 employee financial advisors and 4,961 independent contractors.
Raymond James Financial: The 10-K for fiscal 2025 reports 8,712 total financial advisors as of September 30, 2023, comprising 3,693 employee financial advisors and 5,019 independent contractors.
Raymond James Financial: The investor day deck (published June 5, 2025) reports 8,731 total financial advisors as of March 31, 2025.
